parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The category of the gateway. The default value is `Aliyun`.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the gateway. The description can be 0 to 255 characters in length.

parameters.name: GatewayClass
parameters.description:
<props="china">The gateway class. **This parameter is related to fees**. **For more information, see** [Billable items and billing methods](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126872.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.18.2d7376e8ZmSIJp#concept-126872-zh).</props> <props="intl">The gateway class. **This parameter is related to fees**. **For more information, see** [Billable items and billing methods](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/csg/billable-items-and-billing-methods).</props>

If your gateway is deployed in a data center, which is an on-premises gateway, you can ignore this parameter.

If your gateway is deployed on Alibaba Cloud, which is a cloud gateway, valid values are:

- Basic: Basic
- Standard: Medium
- Enhanced: Enhanced
- Advanced: Performance

parameters.name: Location
parameters.description:
The location of the gateway. Valid values:

- Cloud: cloud gateway.
- On\_Premise: on-premises gateway.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the gateway. The name must be 60 characters in length. The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).

parameters.name: PostPaid
parameters.description:
<props="china">The billing method of the gateway. **This parameter is related to fees**. **For more information, see** [Billable items and billing methods](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126872.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.18.2d7376e8ZmSIJp#concept-126872-zh).</props> <props="intl">The billing method of the gateway. **This parameter is related to fees**. **For more information, see** [Billable items and billing methods](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/csg/billable-items-and-billing-methods).</props> Valid values:

- true: pay-as-you-go.
- false: subscription.

Default value: false (subscription).

parameters.name: PublicNetworkBandwidth
parameters.description:
<props="china">The public bandwidth for data transmission. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 5 to 200. **This parameter is related to fees**. **For more information, see** [Billable items and billing methods](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126872.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.18.2d7376e8ZmSIJp#concept-126872-zh).</props> <props="intl">The public bandwidth for data transmission. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 5 to 200. **This parameter is related to fees**. **For more information, see** [Billable items and billing methods](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/csg/billable-items-and-billing-methods).</props>

> - This parameter is supported only for cloud gateways. You can ignore this parameter for on-premises gateways.
> - Configure this parameter only when you need to mount an OSS bucket across regions.
> - If you specify 0 or do not specify this parameter, the default value is 5.

parameters.name: ReleaseAfterExpiration
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to release the gateway when the subscription expires. Valid values:

true: The gateway is automatically released.

false: The billing method of the gateway is automatically changed to pay-as-you-go after the subscription expires.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource region.

parameters.name: SecondaryVSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch for the secondary node of the high-availability (HA) gateway.

parameters.name: StorageBundleId
parameters.description: The ID of the gateway cluster. You must specify this parameter if you do not specify ResourceRegionId.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the gateway. Valid values:

- File: file gateway.
- Iscsi: iSCSI gateway.

parameters.description:
<props="china">

</props>

<props="intl">

The ID of the instance in an untrusted environment ([CloudBox](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/csg/product-overview/whatis-csg-on-cloud-box)).

</props>

parameters.name: UntrustedEnvInstanceType
parameters.description:
<props="china">

The actual gateway class in an untrusted environment ([CloudBox](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/csg/user-guide/whatis-csg-on-cloud-box?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-53923.d_2_0.55606ae8YwKRow)).

</props>

<props="intl">

The actual gateway class in an untrusted environment ([CloudBox](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/csg/product-overview/whatis-csg-on-cloud-box)).

</props>

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description:
The ID of the virtual switch. If your gateway is deployed in a data center, you can ignore this parameter.

- The vSwitch must be in the same VPC as the ECS instance that you want to attach.
- If no gateway resources can be allocated in the zone where the vSwitch resides, create a vSwitch in another zone.
